1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __without disrupting embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method comprising cold treatment followed by heat treatment and agitation__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b) __wherein the molecular analysis is genotyping__; and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after step (c)__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of __a solution that does not chemically disrupt cell membranes, such as__ water.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Cancelled)

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __mechanical disruption of the shed cellular material without enzymatic treatment__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __purifying and concentrating the DNA through a separation process distinct from the initial collection step__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said __purifying and concentrating__ is performed by __using a solid-phase extraction method with__ magnetic particles to the shed cellular material.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature embryos at a developmental stage prior to desiccation__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos __in a quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed by: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __to correlate genotype with phenotype__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, __selective__ whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained in step (b)__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 14 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __their determined__ genotype __prior to germination in step (d)__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __in a separate germination step__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein __the selection of one or more embryos based on genotype__ is automated.
